review_groups.note: Leopard 2 A8 handover conflict (lead): both statements are correctly attributed and supported. KNDS (19 Nov 2025): handover to the soldiers of both nations to begin April 2026 as contractually agreed; BAAINBw/dpa and Defense News: test vehicles to the Bundeswehr in 2026, delivery to the troops from 2027, all 123 by 2030. Not reconcilable from the documents; lead web check found no report of a Bundeswehr handover by 29 Oct 2026. Treat April 2026 as a manufacturer plan, not as delivery; Bundeswehr row must not exceed roll-out/ordered. Norway handover (P-SA-012) is separate.

Norway delivery of first two A8 NO on 30 Apr 2026 is manufacturer-reported (KNDS release, repeated by Janes citing the KNDS release). Minor source differences (release 29/30 Apr vs 4 May; Levanger start "autumn" vs "Q3 2026") do not affect the delivery date; production start remains future. Lieferung laut Hersteller berichtet.
Handover of first Lot-2 Puma (28 Aug 2026) is a PSM manufacturer statement relayed by media; vehicles go to testing at WTD 81/91, not troop use. Lieferung laut Hersteller berichtet.

SERVAL contract date conflict (lead): Theatrum Belli (notified 31 Dec 2024) and KNDS France release (P-SB-058, Dec 2024) agree; Army Recognition says Feb 2025 - treated as outlier. The statement makes no contract-date assertion; uncertainty documents the divergence. Delivery of first 30 and the 21 Jan 2026 announcement are secondary to the unopened ministry release.

RCH 155 / Ukraine (lead cross-check, unresolved): each claim is supported as an attributed report (ESD 13 Jan 2025: first vehicle presented, to train crews in Germany; Ukrinform 15 Mar 2026: 600 Ukrainians trained, system not yet in Bundeswehr service; esut 15 May 2026: delivery to troops imminent; Militarnyi 6 Sep 2026 citing the unofficial tracker German Aid to Ukraine: Ukraine received first; Drummond X post as reported July 2026: combat testing/combat-proven, adviser not an official statement). Together with P-SB-013 no official confirmation of vehicles delivered to or used by Ukraine exists; combat use unconfirmed; lead web check found no new official source. Matrix must not derive series/operation for RCH 155 from these claims.

RapidFire (lead): P-SB-043 and P-SB-047 describe the NAVAL RAPIDFire (in service on Jacques Chevallier; ammunition order for JAGUAR/RAPIDFire) and P-SB-048 the 40 CTAS component on other vehicles; none establishes a status for RapidFire Land. Land version: unveiled/under development (P-SB-044), two units for the Air and Space Force announced "soon" for operational testing (P-SB-046, June 2025), no later report. See P-SB-045 correction for the 48-unit conflict.

GEPARD (lead): claims are supported as attributed. They concern Gepard transferred from Bundeswehr stocks, KNDS maintenance (KNDS Ukraine), Rheinmetall ammunition (P-SB-051, not KNDS production) and talks/intent; KNDS role as manufacturer/producer of new Gepard is not documented. No series-production or KNDS delivery status derivable.

FLW (lead): P-SB-055 (BMVg) supports FLW 100/FLW 200 Bundeswehr use and the Jan 2025 further FLW 100 purchase but names no manufacturer; the KNDS attribution of FLW 100 rests on P-12 (KNDS catalogue) and P-SB-056 (defence-network, "KNDS stations") and is accepted on that basis. FLW 200 Plus has no order/delivery evidence; status of the FLW 200 Plus variant must not be inferred from FLW 100/200.

KATANA (lead): guidance mode/accuracy differ between product page (GPS/INS/semi-active laser, sub-metre, >40 km), catalogue (GNSS/inertial, decametric, >45 km) and 2024 release (accuracy "few metres"); recorded in the uncertainty. Supported as manufacturer statements; no series evidence.

KATANA/155 mm (lead): catalogue/product listing of KATANA gives no status; P-SC-013 (demonstrator TRL 6, offer within two years from June 2024) has expired by the as-of date without confirmation of qualification/order.

MATARIS (lead): the operational statement (active service since Dec 2025) concerns the MX-10 only and must not be transferred to MV-100, MV-25 or MT-10 although the claim is mapped to those rows (see mapping findings).
CENTURIO (lead): DROIDE framework (DGA with KNDS France/Safran, 30 Dec 2024) names no CENTURIO as subject; claim states this; it must not support a CENTURIO status (see mapping findings).

NERVA/ULTRO (lead): P-SC-040 does not split NERVA types, so no NERVA-XX-specific status follows; P-SC-035 is a video of MT-10 integration on several platforms incl. ULTRO and is no ULTRO test/status evidence.
Supported (EDR 2021); note that the uncertainty "according to Nexter" is not what the article says (editorial statement); non-blocking wording fix for the next portfolio round.

D-LBO (lead): Bundeswehr/BMVg pages are programme-level, name neither KNDS nor ArGe D-LBO; conversion counts (>2,000 converted, target 2,700) cover industry as a whole, not a KNDS share; the troop-use date 1 Jan 2027 relates to the first large unit/NATO commitment. Supported as programme-level facts; the link to the KNDS-Rheinmetall ArGe rests on P-SD-040 and must be shown as programme-level in the profile.

Company/family-level statements (lead): P-SD-050 (CBRN, 70 years), P-SD-010 (MGB and DSB jointly) and P-SD-015 (over 40 armed forces) are supported as manufacturer statements but do not give product-specific status for single rows (cbrn-mask, cbrn-decon, dsb, mgb).
Puma AGSP (lead): supported; the AGSP was developed by Rheinmetall (EUR 118.5m of 119.5m to Rheinmetall electronics); KNDS involvement is only via the PSM joint venture.
Malaysia: KNDS announces acquisition by the Malaysian MoD; the order was formalised between KNDS and local partner ADS; variant and delivery not stated; order only.

AGM/DONAR variants (lead): claims mix the truck-mounted AGM, AGM on Piranha HMC/DONAR 10x10 (Swiss order 2026), tracked ASCOD DONAR (2009 prototype) and AGM in RCH 155; each is supported for its own variant only; no common status for the row.
GFF 4: hobby source (WarWheels.Net), hedged statement; supported only as indication, not decisive for status; prototype status rests on P-SA-063 (2008, historic).
Handover date: the release (12 Dec 2025) reports completion of delivery with a parade; the exact date of the last vehicle handover is not stated, 12 Dec 2025 is the release date.

Lead concurrence: all assigned document findings are A/geprüft for every source of the claim (evidence_items sub-contributions read individually; shared claims carried jointly by all sources); statement, Aussageursprung, event date/status (order vs delivery vs use, manufacturer statement kept visible) and product assignment compared with the findings; no higher status than the sources support. Remaining minor wording notes are in the document findings.
